782926615c82.rationale: It converts Python AST edits into normalized effect sequences, preserving renames, import ordering, and module bindings.

f8bc02ca09f0.label: Definition Insertion Guards
f8bc02ca09f0.rationale: It checks whether adding a definition or method into a Python AST is allowed, rejecting duplicate names and missing target classes.

64ad7be14fc3.label: Import Rewriting
64ad7be14fc3.rationale: It models and applies import edits while preserving module docstring order, deduplicating imports, and replaying changes across multiple files.

ec96ec46d860.label: Statement Unit Extraction
ec96ec46d860.rationale: It walks a function body to collect and distill statement units for graph-only analysis.

8955b13c3e8e.label: Code Rewrite Pipeline
8955b13c3e8e.rationale: It spans AST diffing, edit-effect modeling, statement distillation, and import/definition rewrite operations.

fa1756faac94.label: Code Entity Map
fa1756faac94.rationale: This TUI lets users browse, filter, preview, restore, and revert code entities in a semantic map view.

a548772bed7b.label: Detail View
a548772bed7b.rationale: Displays a detailed text panel for the currently highlighted or selected table row in the TUI.

d30d7a576da1.label: Plan Editing
d30d7a576da1.rationale: It lets the TUI apply, restore, revert, and refresh semantic plans while updating the displayed status from the current input.

cb5d90036e41.label: Blame Visualization
cb5d90036e41.rationale: Adds a TUI palette and glyph rendering to display semantic blame data as colored visual surfaces.

282bd445311d.label: Terminal UI
282bd445311d.rationale: The terminal UI spans the application, color handling, and tests for interactive views such as the code entity map, detail view, plan editing, graph browser, blame visualization, decision browser, and confirmation dialog.

aacbe13b9d8b.label: Decision DAG View
aacbe13b9d8b.rationale: Provides a webview for browsing, revealing, and editing decision nodes and their associated code ranges.

38a4363e605c.label: Code Map View
38a4363e605c.rationale: It adds a VS Code panel for browsing the semantic entity graph, selecting nodes, toggling overlays, and applying mutations from commands.

f046f57d5a76.label: Editor Views
f046f57d5a76.rationale: This subsystem spans the VS Code command, view, preview, and store code that renders the Code Map, Decision DAG View, and Intent Preview.

87d1c57dcdd3.label: History Coordination
87d1c57dcdd3.rationale: This subsystem spans log entry ordering, version-vector clocks, history and causal replay, and merge resolution.

6731bfa6742b.label: Statement Effects
6731bfa6742b.rationale: It covers the AST effect model plus statement diffing, merging, materialization, and slot handling.

e84b32420f06.label: Revision Graph
e84b32420f06.rationale: This subsystem spans the stored operation DAG, decision graph nodes and edges, and node status handling in the graph store.

b5da97df0147.label: Git Repository Binding
b5da97df0147.rationale: Implements repository initialization, commits, snapshot reads, and rollback handling for the store’s Git-backed history.

98dcefe97144.label: Commit Orphan Detection
98dcefe97144.rationale: It tracks Git commit SHAs and flags commits that are not part of the known graph.

5d6a6e44625e.label: Git Integration
5d6a6e44625e.rationale: This subsystem spans binding the tool to Git repositories, detecting orphaned commits, and reading Git trailer metadata.
